children.text: Your baby is due on or around:

Your baby size: ~  50 cm
Your baby weight: ~  2800 - 3900 grams

Week 40:
In pregnancy week 40, the baby has been able to protect herself from difference in temperature thru building up fat under the skin. It will help to survive the temperature outside your womb when the baby arrives in the world soon...
After many weeks of anticipation and preparation, your baby is here! Or maybe not — only 5% of women deliver on their estimated due dates, and many first-time mothers find themselves waiting up to 2 weeks after their due date for their baby to arrive.
